phy-bundle-size-audit 1.0.0

- Initial release of a local JavaScript bundle size auditor and budget enforcer.
- Supports analyzing bundle outputs from webpack, Vite, Rollup, and Next.js.
- Identifies largest chunks, flags those exceeding configurable size budgets, detects duplicate dependencies, and spots treeshaking failures.
- Generates a GitHub PR annotation-ready summary including per-chunk size, gzip estimates, and actionable optimization suggestions.
- Provides CI fail-gate command generation; does not require external APIs or cloud services.
- Includes command-line documentation and example usage in SKILL.md.
